builder_forms:
**1. Sample pre-fill must hard-block, not politely tag — 11/12**
Quote: "one missed 'sample' tag and boilerplate CRP data ends up in a filed 1.2.5" (regops_publisher).
Change: Gate the Author/Complete/Ready-to-file actions behind zero remaining sample-tagged fields, with a per-field explicit acknowledgment and a red blocking banner listing untouched fields.

**2. "Health Canada review" label is misleading — 9/12**
Quote: "Health Canada isn't reviewing anything, and calling it that will confuse less experienced sponsors" (consultant_ex_hc).
Change: Rename to "Pre-check against HC guidance" everywhere, with a persistent disclaimer that no agency has seen the submission.

**3. Checker/validator transparency — 8/12**
Quote: "I don't trust a green light I can't audit" (veteran_contractor).
Change: Make "Valid eCTD" and each review finding click through to a methodology panel: validation ruleset version, rule IDs + severity, cited guidance section and date, and whether the check is deterministic rules or LLM.

**4. Team workflow: sign-off, audit trail, ownership, exports — 7/12**
Quote: "who reviewed, who approved, timestamped — before this replaces anything in our Veeva workflow" (ra_director_cro).
Change: Ship an exportable audit log (user, timestamp, before/after values) plus role-based review/approve e-signature steps, section assignees/due dates, and an exportable status/findings report.

**5. Regulatory scope gaps: lifecycle, bilingual, XML PM — 3/12**
Quote: "nothing here mentions lifecycle — replace/append/delete operations for sequence 0001 onward — and that's where these builder tools usually fall apart" (regops_publisher).
Change: Add lifecycle sequence support (replace/append/delete leaf operations for amendments and solicited responses), plus side-by-side EN/FR authoring and XML Product Monograph handling for Module 1.3.
catalog:
**1. Native browser prompts for destructive/critical actions** — 12/12 respondents.
> "browser confirm() for a permanent delete is not acceptable — give me a proper modal with type-the-ID-to-confirm" (cro_pm)
**Change:** Replace all prompt()/confirm() with in-app modals; delete and ID-reassignment modals require typing the dossier ID to confirm.

**2. Permanent delete — want soft-delete/archive** — 11/12.
> "'Cannot be undone' is not a phrase I want anywhere near a regulatory dossier" (qa_manager)
**Change:** Convert delete to archive with a retention/recovery window (and optional export-before-archive); remove hard delete from the tile UI.

**3. No audit trail or user permissions** — 8/12 (ra_director, qa_manager, consultant-adjacent, regops, cro_pm, veteran, quality_director, cdmo).
> "my clients will ask who deleted what and when" (cdmo_ra_manager)
**Change:** Per-dossier activity log (create/rename/ID-swap/archive with user + timestamp) surfaced via a link on each tile, plus role-based access controls.

**4. Submission type hard-coded to "CS-BE" / unexplained** — 7/12 (ra_officer, consultant, cdmo, labelling, quality_director, ra_junior, cro_pm-adjacent).
> "submission type shows 'CS-BE' but I file plenty of non-BE and post-approval changes" (ra_officer)
**Change:** Make submission type a selectable dropdown at creation, with each code spelled out and a tooltip/glossary.

**5. Placeholder→real ID swap needs guardrails and transparency** — 6/12 (ra_officer, consultant, veteran, labelling, regops, quality_director).
> "tell me what happens to the eCTD sequences when a placeholder ID is swapped — that swap is exactly where errors happen" (labelling_specialist)
**Change:** Pre-commit preview screen for the ID swap listing exactly what will be migrated (documents, sequences, numbering), plus a prominent "NOT FILABLE — draft ID" banner that persists until the real ID is set.

**6. Multi-client/PM operations at scale** — 4/12 (ra_director, cdmo, cro_pm ×2 themes, startup_founder-adjacent).
> "let me filter/group the catalog by client, because a flat grid collapses once I have thirty dossiers across eight sponsors" (cdmo_ra_manager)
**Change:** Add a sponsor/client tag and target-filing-date field to each dossier, with catalog filtering/grouping and exportable status view.
overall:
**1. Browser prompt() for real dossier ID — 12/12**
"A fat-fingered dossier ID is a rejected transmission." (veteran_contractor)
Fix: Replace prompt() with a modal form: format validation, confirm-retype step, impact warning, and an audit-trail entry (user/timestamp/reason).

**2. Storybook tone / "no regulatory background needed" — 12/12**
"'No regulatory background needed' is irresponsible marketing that will generate deficiency letters." (consultant_ex_hc)
Fix: Ship a "professional mode" copy set — neutral regulatory language, drop the tagline; keep guided explanations as optional inline help.

**3. 3D submission tower is a gimmick — 11/12**
"The 3D tower is decoration I'd trade for a plain module completeness table." (consultant_ex_hc)
Fix: Make the tower a collapsible/off-by-default toggle; default view is a plain eCTD-backbone checklist table.

**4. "Ready to file" not traceable to rules — 9/12**
"The 'Ready to file' chip needs to show exactly what it checked... or I can't defend it in an audit." (quality_director_newcomer)
Fix: Click-through itemized validation report citing the specific HC validation rule and guidance version per check, exportable as printable PDF.

**5. Hard delete of dossiers — 6/12**
"There should be no permanent deletion of submission records, period — archive it." (qa_manager)
Fix: Replace delete with archive + export-before-archive; deletion restricted or removed entirely.

**6. No path past the demo: eCTD export, lifecycle sequences, enterprise needs — 6/12**
"Show me how it handles sequence 0001 with replace/append operators before I take it seriously." (regops_publisher)
Fix: Ship validated eCTD XML export (CESG/WebTrader-loadable) plus sequence 0001 lifecycle support as the next roadmap slice; surface roles/permissions and bilingual support on the published roadmap.
journey:
**1. Unserious branding/tone — 12/12**
Every respondent flagged the "file a drug like a story" tagline and/or "no regulatory background needed" as credibility-destroying and liable to invite unqualified filers.
> "don't let 'No regulatory background needed' anywhere near a filing tool, because that invites the wrong people to file unsupervised." — qa_manager

Change: Strip both lines; replace with sober copy ("Guided ANDS filing, step by step") plus a persistent "requires a qualified responsible party" disclaimer.

**2. Fees step is a bare self-attest checkbox — 8/12**
The single "small-business status already granted" checkbox skips fee-category selection, evidence, and the granted-vs-applied distinction.
> "a self-attested checkbox on a fee category is an audit finding waiting to happen." — qa_manager

Change: Expand into a fee sub-flow: fee-category picker, granted/applied-for/none radio, required upload of the HC confirmation letter, and a link to the mitigation-of-fees process.

**3. No exportable record / audit trail — 7/12**
QA, PMs, and contractors all need paper: printable step-by-step summaries, validation results, and client/manager status reports.
> "when Health Canada calls, I need paper in front of me, not a progress bar." — veteran_contractor

Change: Add "Export dossier record" — a timestamped PDF/CSV audit log of every step, actor, validation result, and receipt, suitable for QMS/client reporting.

**4. Opaque validation — 6/12**
"N errors to fix" without rule IDs, severity, or the HC validation-profile version is unusable for publishers.
> "'✗ N error(s) to fix' with no rule IDs or severity is useless to a publisher." — regops_publisher

Change: Show each error with its Health Canada validation rule number and severity, and display the validation profile name + version on the validation step.

**5. 3D module tower is decoration — 6/12**
Professionals want a flat, exportable Module 1–5 tree matching the eCTD backbone with document counts.
> "drop the 3D tower for a plain table of contents like an eCTD backbone — that's what reviewers and consultants actually read." — veteran_contractor

Change: Replace (or default away from) the tower with a flat eCTD-backbone tree view showing per-section document counts, exportable to CSV.

**6. No collaboration/timeline model — 4/12**
CRO/CDMO users need multi-dossier and multi-client workspaces, roles, step owners, and due dates.
> "I need per-client separation, role-based access for my 5-person team, and an exportable audit log." — cdmo_ra_manager

Change: Add step-level assignment (owner + due date) with role-based access and per-client dossier workspaces.
operations:
1. **Hidden navigation** — 12/12 respondents.
Quote: "put Registry and Correspondence in the top bar — hidden pages don't exist for real users" (consultant_ex_hc).
Change: Add a persistent top nav bar linking Portfolio, Registry, and Correspondence on all three pages.

2. **Browser-only checklist, no audit trail** — 12/12.
Quote: "a reminder my team cannot share across five people and two offices is worse than no reminder, because it creates false confidence" (cdmo_ra_manager).
Change: Move the annual notification checklist to server-side storage with per-item user, timestamp, and sign-off fields.

3. **"Fee …" loading flicker** — 9/12.
Quote: "a fee chip that flickers looks unreliable" (ra_director_cro).
Change: Fetch fee data in the same request as the dossier rows (or block CSV export until resolved) so chips never render as placeholders.

4. **Unverifiable day-counters** — 3/12 (ra_director_cro, consultant_ex_hc, veteran_contractor).
Quote: "If I can't audit the clock, I won't trust the clock" (veteran_contractor).
Change: Add a hover/expand on every counter showing the source date, statutory basis, and calculation (e.g., "NOA served 2026-05-20 + 45 days per s.7(1)(d)").

5. **Free-text dossier ID entry** — 3/12 (ra_director_cro, ra_officer_generic, regops_publisher).
Quote: "let me pick a dossier from a list instead of typing IDs" (ra_director_cro).
Change: Replace dossier ID text inputs with a searchable dropdown populated from existing dossiers.

6. **Acronym opacity for non-experts** — 3/12 (ra_junior, startup_founder, quality_director_newcomer).
Quote: "give every acronym in the notice inbox a hover definition — this is my first ANDS" (quality_director_newcomer).
Change: Add hover tooltips with plain-English definitions for every notice/patent term (NOA, Form V, s.6, NOC, etc.).

Notable singletons (below threshold but high-stakes): per-client access segregation (cdmo_ra_manager), owner/blocked-on fields (cro_pm), bilingual/French UI (labelling_specialist), CESG/WebTrader correspondence import (regops_publisher).
onboarding:
**1. Server-side workspace identity (12/12)**
Workspace name lives in browser storage and can go blank on other devices.
> "If I sign in on the boardroom laptop for a client status call, it needs to show the right client name every time." — cro_pm

Change: Persist workspace name/ID on the account record server-side; render the user chip and workspace header from the API on every session.

**2. Real email delivery for reset codes (12/12)**
On-screen one-time code reads as a security hole, not production-ready.
> "Deliver reset codes by email like a grown-up system." — veteran_contractor

Change: Wire transactional email for reset codes with a delivery audit log; until then, label the on-screen code "demo mode only."

**3. MFA / SSO (9/12)**
Email+password alone fails corporate IT and client security questionnaires.
> "No multinational's IT security will let a submission tool into production on email-plus-password alone." — regops_publisher

Change: Add TOTP-based MFA plus SAML/OIDC SSO (Azure AD, Google Workspace), with a per-workspace admin policy toggle (incl. configurable password rules).

**4. Workspace model clarity for non-CRO users (8/12)**
CRO-centric "client company" copy confuses sponsors, in-house RA, manufacturers, and multi-sponsor contractors.
> "Reword the CRO-centric copy so a sponsor company doesn't feel like a second-class user." — startup_founder

Change: On signup, ask "Filing for your own company or for clients?" and branch the copy, placeholder examples, and a one-line workspace explainer accordingly.

**5. Terminology / first-run onboarding (5/12)**
"Registry," "Correspondence," "Portfolio," "dossier" appear undefined; newcomers freeze on landing.
> "'Registry' and 'Portfolio' mean nothing to a man with thirty years of NDSs behind him." — veteran_contractor

Change: Add one-line tooltips on every landing-page chip mapping terms to eCTD/regulatory vocabulary, plus a "start with the Guided journey" first-login pointer.

**6. Team invites & multi-workspace switching (5/12)**
No visible way to invite teammates, set roles, or switch between client workspaces under one account.
> "I coordinate five to ten people per filing — show me during signup how I get my team and the client into the workspace." — cro_pm

Change: Add an "Invite your team" step at workspace creation and let one account own/join multiple workspaces via a header switcher.

Also raised but below threshold: data-residency/audit-trail statement on the login card (3), FR/EN bilingual toggle (1, but legally significant for Health Canada).
ai_draft:
**1. Hidden "Review vs Health Canada" step (12/12)**
The post-save review instruction lives in a screen-reader-only region and the review action is buried under "Sample & edit."
Quote: "make the 'review vs Health Canada' step a visible, blocking workflow with a documented reviewer sign-off, not a tooltip suggestion" — qa_manager
Change: After "Use this draft," show a blocking on-screen banner with a one-click "Review vs Health Canada" button, and hold the section in a "needs review" state (visible in tree/progress bar) until review is completed.

**2. Broken no-API-key error message (12/12)**
The fallback message exposes the raw GROQ_API_KEY env var name and points to an "Author button below" that's under another tab.
Quote: "my regulatory staff should never see an environment variable name, and the misdirected 'button below' reference is sloppy" — ra_director_cro
Change: Replace with plain-language copy ("AI drafting isn't configured — contact your administrator") that links directly to the actual Author location; never surface env-var names.

**3. Confusing labels and jargon (7/12)**
"Sample & edit," "✦AI," and raw md5 checksums are unclear to non-technical regulatory users and unusable in SOPs.
Quote: "'✦AI' and 'Sample & edit' as mode names are cute but my SOPs need unambiguous labels I can screenshot into a work instruction" — cdmo_ra_manager
Change: Rename "Sample & edit" to "Template & compliance review," and show "Reviewed by / version / date" by default with the md5 checksum behind an expandable "technical details" toggle.

**4. Opaque validation and guidance basis (4/12)**
Users can't interrogate what "Valid eCTD" checks or which guidance version drafts are pinned to.
Quote: "a green flag I can't interrogate means nothing in publishing" — regops_publisher
Change: Make each gate flag expandable to a rule report (rule IDs mapped to Health Canada validation rules) and pin/display the guidance document version per section, with drafts citing the guidance paragraph they satisfy.

**5. Data residency and client isolation (3/12)**
QA/legal can't approve without knowing where chat/draft data goes and whether sponsors are isolated.
Quote: "I cannot put Sponsor A's ANDS content into a shared model serving Sponsor B" — cdmo_ra_manager
Change: Publish an in-product data-handling statement (processing location, residency, per-dossier isolation, retention) linked from the AI chip, plus per-sponsor usage reporting.

**6. Review/assignment tracking at dossier level (3/12)**
No way to see which AI drafts are unreviewed, who owns them, or export status for clients/inspectors.
Quote: "give me a dossier-level view of which sections are AI-drafted but unreviewed, with who's assigned — that's the report my clients will ask for" — cro_pm
Change: Add an exportable dossier dashboard listing each section's AI-drafted/reviewed status, assignee, and audit-trail provenance, with the AI chip carried into the export manifest.
validate_export:
**1. Silent export when validator is offline — 12/12 respondents**
Quote: "Fix the silent offline export first: block export or stamp the package UNVALIDATED, no third option." (cdmo_ra_manager)
Change: Hard-block export whenever validation cannot run; the only escape is an explicit acknowledgment that stamps the archive filename, cover page, and dossier tile "NOT VALIDATED".

**2. Flimsy browser confirm / unaudited override — 12/12**
Quote: "That dialog is a $180k decision and it looks like a JavaScript popup." (startup_founder)
Change: Replace `confirm()` with an in-app modal that lists all findings, requires a typed justification, writes who/when/why to the Audit trail, and watermarks the resulting package "INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY".

**3. No exportable validation report — 7/12** (ra_director_cro, ra_officer_generic, qa_manager, consultant_ex_hc, veteran_contractor, cdmo_ra_manager, cro_pm)
Quote: "A badge on screen is not documentation I can defend in an audit." (ra_director_cro)
Change: Bundle a timestamped PDF validation report (full findings list, pass/fail, rule version, override record) inside every export and offer it as a standalone download.

**4. Rule provenance unclear — 5/12** (ra_officer_generic, consultant_ex_hc, regops_publisher, veteran_contractor, cdmo_ra_manager)
Quote: "State the exact HC validation criteria version the CA-E/CA-W rules map to, with a link to each rule's text." (consultant_ex_hc)
Change: Display the Health Canada eCTD validation rules version + last-updated date on the validation card and report, with each CA-E/CA-W code linking to the official rule text.

**5. Jargon and findings need plain-language help — 5/12** (ra_junior, startup_founder, cro_pm, labelling_specialist, quality_director_newcomer)
Quote: "Add plain-language descriptions and maybe a 'how to fix' link for each CA-E/CA-W finding." (ra_junior)
Change: Add a "what this means & how to fix" expander on every finding plus glossary tooltips for sequence/leaf/lifecycle and sequence-purpose options.

Notable singletons (not themes): all-errors-by-default (2), lifecycle operators on leaves (regops_publisher), French/bilingual UI + Module 1 CA checks (labelling_specialist), owners/dates on findings (cro_pm), tenant isolation (cdmo_ra_manager).
